name: Data Exposure Prevention
description: Scans outbound tool call parameters for sensitive data patterns and blocks transmission to unauthorized destinations.
threat_addressed: Sensitive data can leave the agent's control through three vectors: outbound actions (tool calls carrying sensitive payloads), agent-generated output (responses containing sensitive data), and context ingestion (tool responses introducing sensitive data the agent didn't request).
enforcement_mechanism: Three enforcement layers operate inline: Layer A (Outbound Action Scanning) evaluates action payloads against classification patterns. Layer B (Output Scanning) evaluates agent-generated output before delivery. Layer C (Context Ingestion Evaluation) evaluates data entering context at point of entry.

security_outcome.pass: Layer A scanning per outbound action. Layer B scanning per output. Layer C validation on all ingested data. No unscanned outbound actions.
security_outcome.fail: Sensitive data detected going to unauthorized destination.

display_detail: Scans outbound tool call parameters for sensitive data patterns and validates destination authorization.
remediation_hint_template: Sensitive data patterns detected in outbound parameters. To approve this tool for sensitive data, run: ancilis approve-tool {tool_name} --classification {classification}
